item: MetaZoo Mothman 1/1 (Steve Aoki x Gal Yosef)
sale_price_source: Sotheby's lot page (Natively Digital, Lot 52): final bid $170,000 + 26% buyer's premium = $214,200 sold. Corroborated by PSA ($214,000 at close, rounded).
winner_handle: ak09 (per the Sotheby's bid feed and Aoki's since-deleted congrats tweet)
lot_composition: The NFT: animated Steve Aoki x Gal Yosef MetaZoo Mothman
A physical PSA-graded 1/1 MetaZoo Mothman card (the reason PSA tweeted about it in 2022)
Nightfall booster boxes (per recollection; UNVERIFIED — not stated in either tweet)
note: One event: the Oct-2021 Sotheby's close ($214k). PSA's 2022 tweet is about the physical graded card that accompanied the NFT lot, not a second sale. Independent third parties (Sotheby's, PSA) still have their posts live, while Aoki's own announcements of the same sale are deleted (recovered in tweets_aoki_deleted.json).
price_note: Price CONFIRMED from the Sotheby's lot page: final bid $170,000 (bidder ak09) plus Sotheby's 26% buyer's premium (25% premium + 1% overhead) equals the $214,200 sold price. PSA's 'climbed to $214,000 at close' is the same figure rounded. Earlier repo notes marked this disputed because the price was not in the 6 Wayback lot-page snapshots and is not on-chain (Sotheby's settled off-chain; all token transfers carry 0 ETH); the lot page resolves it.

onchain.settlement: Sotheby's auctions settle off-chain; the NFT shipped to the winner as a zero-value transfer. No sale price is recorded on-chain (contrast: OpenSea sales carry ETH value).

royalty.note: royaltyInfo(1017, 1e18) -> 0.1 ETH to 0xa6d3...; this wallet is ALSO the minter of #1017 and the Sotheby's consignor/seller (Aoki creator/royalty wallet). Collection-wide observed royalty avg 9.95% across 786 secondary sales.
royalty.mothman_secondary_sales: 0 (Alchemy getNFTSales) -> $0 secondary royalty earned on #1017; post-auction transfers were private/non-market moves

auction_split_estimate.assumption: CONFIRMED premium-inclusive: hammer $170,000, buyer paid $214,200 all-in (26% buyer's premium = 25% premium + 1% overhead). Aoki's consignor gross is the hammer minus any seller's commission, minus the private split with Gal Yosef.
auction_split_estimate.sothebys: ~$44,200 (26% buyer's premium on the $170,000 hammer: $170,000 x 0.26). A seller's commission (negotiable, unknown) would add to this, so ~$44,200 is a floor on Sotheby's take.
auction_split_estimate.aoki_consignor_gross: ~$170,000 hammer, minus unknown seller's commission and minus private payment to Gal Yosef
auction_split_estimate.correction_note: An earlier version of this block double-counted the premium (treated $214,200 as the hammer and added another 26%, giving Sotheby's ~$55,640 / buyer ~$269,640). The lot page confirms $214,200 is the all-in sold price, so Sotheby's premium is ~$44,200, not ~$55,640.

transfers.note: mint to creator; matches lot createdAt
